metadata.project: CODARIS Runtimes & Execution Platforms educational research dataset
metadata.scope: Extensive curated A-Z catalogue of language runtimes, virtual machines, JavaScript engines, WebAssembly runtimes, managed runtimes, native runtime systems, browser contexts, edge/serverless execution platforms, embedded runtimes and accelerator runtimes.
metadata.taxonomy_warning: A language runtime, VM implementation, JavaScript engine, runtime library and managed serverless execution platform are different layers. CODARIS should keep runtime_type, family and engine/host relations visible.
metadata.usage_warning: State of JS and Stack Overflow metrics use different survey populations and questions. Do not combine them into one universal runtime market-share score.
